description: This file defines an abstract class 'AbstractRule' within the AWS SDK's EndpointV2 rule system. It provides base functionality for rule classes, including condition evaluation logic.

classes.name: AbstractRule
classes.description: An abstract class representing a rule within a rule set, containing properties for conditions and documentation, and methods for condition evaluation.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes an AbstractRule instance with a definition array containing conditions and optionally documentation.

methods.name: getConditions
methods.description: Returns the list of conditions for this rule.

methods.name: getDocumentation
methods.description: Returns the documentation associated with this rule.

methods.name: evaluateConditions
methods.description: Evaluates all conditions of the rule against provided input parameters using the standard library.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Abstract method subclasses must implement to evaluate the rule given input parameters and access to the standards library.
